diff --git a/kernel/bpf/verifier.c b/kernel/bpf/verifier.c
index 53007182b46b..dafb250f6162 100644
--- a/kernel/bpf/verifier.c
+++ b/kernel/bpf/verifier.c
@@ -2334,6 +2334,16 @@ static void __update_reg32_bounds(struct bpf_reg_state *reg)
 	reg->u32_min_value = max_t(u32, reg->u32_min_value, (u32)var32_off.value);
 	reg->u32_max_value = min(reg->u32_max_value,
 				 (u32)(var32_off.value | var32_off.mask));
+	/* If the intersection of the bounds and the var_off is empty,
+	 * the range is empty.  This can happen because we learned something
+	 * new about the var_off (e.g. from a JEQ) that conflicts with
+	 * the previous bounds.  There is no "empty set" for a register,
+	 * so we just clamp the min to the max.
+	 */
+	if ((s32)reg->s32_min_value > (s32)reg->s32_max_value)
+		reg->s32_min_value = reg->s32_max_value;
+	if (reg->u32_min_value > reg->u32_max_value)
+		reg->u32_min_value = reg->u32_max_value;
 }
